title: The Oil Rainbow in the Wet Yard
youtube_title: The Oil Rainbow in the Wet Yard | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Not every treasure needs to be pocketed.
summary: At a bedroom window on a frosty morning, Kavi finds a thin oil rainbow by the bike, pretty and not to touch. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Kavi shows Remy how to look without disturbing it. Auntie June looks too, and they leave it where it is.
